description: Admin dashboard page. Contains sensitive information including the FLAG exposed via HTML attribute. Requires valid admin session to access.

details.authentication: Required - role must be 'admin' in session

notes: CRITICAL: Flag is exposed in HTML via Jinja2 template variable. Hint in page text: 'Dig deeper and maybe try to view me' referring to the flag attribute. Flag loaded from environment variable FLAG or defaults to 'flag{this_is_a_fake_flag}'. To see flag, must: 1) Login as admin user, 2) Pass 2FA verification (code=1234), 3) View page source or inspect element.
